extracted.name: Prawn tagliatelle with courgettes
extracted.description: Make this king prawn and courgette tagliatelle in just 20 minutes. It's full of garlic, lemon and chilli, and it's healthy too, so it's great for busy weeknights
ingredient_lines: 150g raw king prawns peeled and deveined
½ small bunch of parsley finely chopped
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the courgette for 4-5 mins, then stir through the garlic and chilli.
Cook the tagliatelle following pack instructions. Drain, reserving some of the cooking water.

Add the prawns to the courgette mixture, and cook for 2 mins until pink. Toss through the tagliatelle, the lemon zest and juice, parsley, some seasoning and a splash of the reserved cooking water. Divide between bowls and serve.
